question: After everything shipped or in flight on 2026-09-22, which alert types that fired in the last 30 days still have NO owner that will stop them recurring?
answer_first: 126 types fired on 359 fire-days (383 alerts, 126 returns) over 2026-08-24..2026-09-22. By fire-day weight (split view): CLOSED 216, IN FLIGHT 67, RULING 19, DIGEST-ONLY 37, UNOWNED 20.

NO OWNER that stops recurrence, for types that actually recur: match-soundness NEW-CONTESTED (12 fire-days under the retired parent key, 1 under its own), ff-catalog-* (10), ff-carry (8), store-registry unregistered capture prefix (3), plus residuals inside partly closed types: the watchdog RUN RECORD double page, chain failures that need same-morning data (20fecf), and send-alert's default subject 'Grocery pipeline alert' (2). None of these is in plan-8 or plan-9. Plan-8 and plan-9 listed the digest types that fired under their CURRENT key, while 70 fire-days of history sit on the five keys retired on 09-21 (inferred from plan-9's evidence line, not from their scoping code). That explains ff-catalog-*; it does not fully explain match-soundness-new-contested (1 fire of its own on 09-22) or ff-carry (8 fires on an unchanged key), whose omission is not established.

Projection if every in-flight item lands: existing types 18 to 106 fire-days per 30 (observed 306 on the same types, triage-created excluded), of which 11 to 35 have no owner that stops them; plus new one-off detector types 14 to 29; plus triage-created residuals 53 to 122 (the triage lane's own work items, never emailed, but the census counts them). Risk R1 (the knowledge store's judgement nights) could add up to 26 and is unmeasured.

The RETURN RATE will fall for weeks for reasons that are NOT recurrence stopping: the 09-21 split created 75 successor keys whose first fire cannot be a return, each price disagreement is its own key, and 53 of the 383 alerts are triage-created residuals that can never return (0 of their 53 alerts were returns). Excluding them, today's rate is 126 of 330 (38.2%), not 32.9%.

method: Per-type fire-days from the census rows (one row per date x type) joined to every queue and archive item by type key, and every item to the plans of 2026-09-22 (-1, -2, -3, -4, -5 from its worktree, -6 from its worktree, -7, -8, -9) by queue_id.

Each type got ONE primary class. CLOSED requires a root-cause commit that is an ancestor of origin/main (checked with git merge-base --is-ancestor); a fix in a worktree is IN FLIGHT; a fix planned in plan-9 is IN FLIGHT; a type waiting on a named Brad question is RULING; resolver digest with no lane and no plan is DIGEST-ONLY; everything else is UNOWNED.

41 recurring or high-impact types and 31 queue ids were classified by hand from bodies, close notes, registry notes and plans (how_classified type-rule / id-rule / special). The remaining 54 one-shot types were classified mechanically: resolved -> CLOSED with any commit hash in its close note verified on origin/main (prevents: 'unassessed'), ruling resolver -> RULING, open -> UNOWNED.

The five catch-all types retired on 09-21 (capture-watchdog, match-soundness, store-registry-drift, ff-catalog-degrading, automation-silent-death: 70 fire-days) were classified by the conditions in their bodies, because a split relabels future fires and stops none of them.

Projection: per type, a low and high fire-days per 30 AFTER every in-flight item lands, stated in each row with its basis. These are judgements, not measurements: no SLO is declared (reliability-craft: an SLO declared before the data exists is a wish).

findings_for_the_program: A SPLIT IS NOT A FIX. The five catch-alls retired on 09-21 held 70 of 359 fire-days (19.5%). Their successors are 75 new registry entries (70 from plan-2026-09-21-5, 5 from plan-2026-09-21-7): 30 are review class with resolver digest (queued, no lane), 4 are digest class, 2 are unassigned. Only 5 of them have fired in the window (match-soundness-new-contested, watchdog-computed-but-not-shipped, watchdog-run-record, watchdog-browser-capture-missing-today, store-registry-hardcoded-store-list). A scope that asks 'which digest types fired' over current keys cannot see the rest until each fires again: that explains the ff-catalog-* successors and plan-8's count of 0 for the attended-browser types. match-soundness-new-contested (1 fire of its own, 12 under the parent) and ff-carry (8 fires under an unchanged key) are also absent from both plans, for a reason not established here.

The RETURN RATE is about to improve for measurement reasons alone: new successor keys, one key per price-disagreement cell, and triage residuals are all structurally unable to score a return. A quiet type and a relabelled type look the same on the scoreboard.

The triage lane is the census's largest single source: 52 one-shot types in the 13 days since 2026-09-10, never emailed, each costing a triage read. Nothing measures or owns that minting rate, and 16 of them were abandoned open by the 09-17 reset.

Two emitters for one condition still stands in three places: watchdog-run-record beside each failing lane's own page; board-prices-aging beside ad-window-no-capture; cross-store-integrity beside db-constraint-refused (one audit). F1 in the RCA names the pattern for FACTS; nothing in today's plans applies it to ALERTS.
could_not_prove: The 'RUN RECORD on about 17 of 20 days' figure reads the bodies of 15 capture-watchdog ids; a recurrence absorbed into an open id is dated but its body is not, so recurrence days were attributed to the parent id's conditions.
Whether capture-run exits nonzero when guards exit 4 (quarantine); if it does, every quarantine also raises watchdog-run-record and rank 3 and rank 4 are one source.
batch-stalled's 19 quiet days may mean no recipe batch ran, not that the class stopped.
walmart-capture-aging's 08-31 fix commit was not re-derived; the classification rests on plan-9's statement and 22 quiet days.
37 mechanically CLOSED one-shot types are marked prevents 'unassessed'; their close notes were not judged class vs instance.
Every projected range is a judgement with its basis in the row, not a measurement. The ranges for IN FLIGHT lanes depend on classifier precision nobody has measured yet.

Plan-4's items are marked done with no shipped_commit because the knowledge store lives outside the repo; the recall-sleep classification rests on 0879dd53f, 3005162d5 and 1a9250b3d on origin/main and on plan-4's own record.
